subject: Provisioning roadmap for evaluation kit & staging access
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Torres <alejandra@novusretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning roadmap for evaluation kit & staging access

Hi Alejandra —

Great to connect yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a lightweight provisioning roadmap so Novus can run your suites against a short-lived staging endpoint without exposing production data. High level:

- Week 0 (this week): scope dataset subsets and prompt packs we will provision; sign MAP (usage constraints + retention).
- Week 1: Redwood prepares a gated staging endpoint and a provisioned eval bucket; we ingest the dataset subset and upload the prompt pack.
- Week 2: Novus runs testcases, we capture token-level metrics and any quality diffs.
- Week 3: joint review + decision point for expansion / longer-term Dedicated capacity.

Two important guardrails we discussed:
- Usage constraint: dataset/testcases are limited to internal evaluation by Novus reviewers and may not be used to train or fine-tune external models.
- Retention: Redwood will automatically purge staging copies 30 days after the final test run unless Novus requests archival for compliance reviews.

If that timeline looks reasonable I’ll send a short MAP and a dataset manifest for your legal and security review. I can also attach a small sample of the prompt pack (redacted).

Attachments: eval_dataset_v1_manifest.csv (list of files & sample hashes)

Next steps: would you be available for a 30-min handoff on Thursday 09/16 to walk through the sample and provisioning steps?

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0132

From: Alejandra Torres <alejandra@novusretail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Novus Retail Procurement <procure@novusretail.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning roadmap for evaluation kit & staging access

Hi Irene —

Thanks, that plan is helpful and straightforward. A few quick things from our side:

1) Security: we will need an inventory of data fields in the sample and confirmation that any PII is redacted. Please include the hashing/salting approach you use for identifiers.
2) Licensing: procurement will want the usage constraint language in the MAP so they can accept the non-training clause. I’ve looped them on this thread.
3) Timing: Thursday 9/16 works for a 30-min walkthrough; can we do 10am PT?

Also, would you be able to provide a 10–15 record JSONL sample of the prompt pack and a short README that calls out expected tokenization/encoding? Helps our engineers verify local sanity checks before they hit the staging endpoint.

Best,
Alejandra Torres
Principal, Data Science | Novus Retail
alejandra@novusretail.com

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Torres <alejandra@novusretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Novus Retail Procurement <procure@novusretail.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning roadmap for evaluation kit & staging access

Alejandra —

10am PT on Thursday works; calendar invite incoming. I attached a redacted 15-record prompt sample and a short README that documents tokenization expectations and recommended test-case ordering.

Security notes (quick):
- Sample records have all PII replaced with deterministic salted hashes; we’ll include the salt reference in the MAP so Novus can confirm reproducibility for audit purposes.
- We’ll provision the staging endpoint inside an isolated VPC with short-lived credentials (24-hour tokens for each run) and audit logs exported to a customer-owned S3 if you want.

Attached: prompt_pack_v1_readme.md, sample_testcases_subset.jsonl (15 records)

On the MAP itself, we propose the following minimal clauses:
- Evaluation-only: no training/fine-tuning; derivative outputs may be used internally for product decisions.
- Retention: staging data purge after 30 days post-test; logs retained for 90 days for debugging unless otherwise requested.
- Disclosure: Novus may share high-level aggregated results externally but not verbatim dataset/testcases.

Marissa (cc’d) — can you draft a 1-page MAP + checklist we can send to procurement today? Karthik — flag any infra constraints if 10am PT shows a problem.

Thanks,
Irene

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Alejandra Torres <alejandra@novusretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Provisioning roadmap for evaluation kit & staging access

Hey all —

Quick follow-up after the call: action items and tentative dates.

- ACTION (Redwood): send 1-page MAP + dataset manifest for procurement sign-off — due 2026-09-17 EOD.
- ACTION (Novus): confirm non-training clause language or propose edits — due 2026-09-20.
- ACTION (Redwood): provision staging endpoint and upload sample dataset subset — scheduled for 2026-09-21.
- ACTION (Joint): run first test sweep and submit metrics to the shared Drive folder — target window 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-24.

Notes from security: we will NOT allow retention beyond the agreed 30-day purge without an explicit written request and business justification. Procurement asked for a DocuSign link for the MAP; Alejandra, I’ll draft the doc and share the link by tomorrow.

Attachments: eval_dataset_v1_manifest.csv

Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alejandra Torres <alejandra@novusretail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Novus Retail Procurement <procure@novusretail.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning roadmap for evaluation kit & staging access

Marissa / Irene —

Thanks for the follow-ups and the doc draft. Procurement reviewed the MAP and proposed one small edit clarifying that aggregated performance metrics can be shared with partners but not raw testcase contents. They also asked for the DocuSign envelope to include the company signing block. Procurement confirms target to sign on 09/24, which lines up with your scheduled staging window.

We confirm the expected staging start on 09/21; our engineers will run the first sweep 09/22. Please go ahead with provisioning.

Best,
Alejandra
